info.title: AutoTriager Workbench - Proposed Runtime API
info.description: Author: Dahe Chen. Design specification only. No endpoint is claimed implemented. Initial deployment: one local user, same-origin SPA/API, loopback only, fixture or offline replay. GET / (outside this API) bootstraps an application-controlled HttpOnly SameSite=Strict at_session cookie. GET capabilities returns a session-bound anti-CSRF value. POST requires exact allowed Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Provider, engine and gateway credentials never reach the browser.

post.summary: Create an immutable run attempt; model, scope, budget and history are server-owned
post.description: Offline inference with missing model configuration or authorization returns HTTP 409 before dispatch and creates no billable attempt. Fixture mode does not call a provider. Same idempotency key/body replays the same run; a changed body conflicts. A parent must belong to this investigation and be terminal.

202.description: Accepted run or exact idempotent replay. May remain queued while an earlier provider dispatch is unresolved.

get.summary: Replay and tail the application's durable event journal
get.description: Each frame is event: <event_type>, id: <sequence>, data: <Event JSON>. This is not a Holmes replay API. The client may supply after or Last-Event-ID; if both are set they must agree. Initial cursor 0 replays from the beginning. Disconnect never triggers another model request. Heartbeats are SSE comments without sequence advancement. Cursor errors are sent before starting SSE. Full MVP journals are retained; a future retention gap must return STREAM_CURSOR_EXPIRED rather than silently omitting events.

200.description: SSE stream containing versioned Event envelopes. Terminal runs replay to EOF; an empty tail does not change run state.

post.summary: Fence logical run execution; does not promise remote provider termination
post.description: Idempotent for repeated cancel requests. No body. Cancel is not an approval of any suggested remediation. Historical evidence remains readable to the authorized user. An unresolved external dispatch keeps its global slot and reservation after logical cancellation.

200.description: Current cancellation receipt, including possible remaining external work.

localSession.name: at_session
localSession.description: Application-controlled local session. Not an enterprise login/RBAC implementation. HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict; Secure flag when HTTPS is deployed.

ToolReply.description: Private read-only gateway materialization; not a browser HTTP route. Contains actual admitted records, not just evidence IDs. Entire serialized payload is scoped, persisted and charged before return.
